The project

The story behind it.

The project

El Kul is an independent space for Libyans, promoting social inclusion, women's participation and citizen engagement in an information environment shaped by severe disinformation.

What she did

Khadija directed El Kul's strategic content production to counter disinformation, and managed a decentralised network of freelance digital creators working inside Libya.

Impact

El Kul has grown to over 1.2 million followers. In 2022 it won Best Trust Initiative at the WAN-IFRA African Digital Media Awards.
